newsitem.title: NORWAY: Handelsbanken buys Platou share activities.
newsitem.headline: Handelsbanken buys Platou share activities.

text.p: The Norwegian arm of Sweden's Handelsbanken said on Monday it had agreed to takeover the activities of brokerage house R.S. Platou Securities, which shut down operations last month after a share-issue scandal.
Handelsbanken said Platou's strong position in analysis, corporate finance and institutional share dealing would underpin the bank's offensive strategy.
The bank said it would pay R.S. Platou to take over the operations, but declined to comment on the amount.
R.S. Platou Securities, one of Norway's leading brokerage houses, decided to close down in March after regulatory authorities withdrew part of its licence to operate.

The Banking, Insurance and Securities Commission ruled that Platou was no longer permitted to administer share issues for clients following a scandal concerning an issue in Norwegian Applied Technology. It was still able to run its other operations.
The company announced after the ruling that it would close completely.
Handelsbanken said 25 out of 33 Platou employees had accepted an offer to transfer jobs, bringing Handelsbanken Markets' workforce in Norway to 80.
